Surprised by this unexpected and confusing event, his men were thrown into a state of pan- ic. Unlike the crew, Pericles was undaunted. He walked up to a lead steersman, removed the cloak he was wearing, and held it up around the man's face. He asked the man if he was scared of what he saw. No, of course not.
